verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a secret-scanning CLI with a related GitHub Action. Comparable products in this category can expose APIs, so an API reference is a fair question. The evidence documents CLI commands with static examples and a GitHub workflow integration, but no interactive API reference or runnable API examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
